files.extraction: Adapted channel, late-result semantics, bounded timeout. Typed historical records rather than raw JSON logging.

adaptations: Package imports only for copied sources and tests. App-facing privacy facade is additional, not a replacement of the original logger.

dev.2 resource monitor and its original tests copied; native Android namespace placeholder, Windows resource channel block extracted into standalone registration helper. Native source not yet built in a consumer.

dev.3: preserve original console layout and filters; replace GitHub upload action with local history and resources. Display/copy only fixed-vocabulary entries, bound console by original ring, add confirmation for deletion, hidden tap wrapper and framework/root-isolate error capture. Added visible resource panel. No remote transport.

dev.4 app startup and information; process exit adapter excludes raw descriptions, names, status, abort traces and managed cause; no extra crash interceptor. Historical Android API 30+ records displayed separately, unsupported not treated as no crash.

dev.5: additive resource fields and native measurements: Android app-data volume StatFs and process CPU core-equivalent delta; Windows executable volume GetDiskFreeSpaceExW. GPU and unsupported readings remain unavailable. Local UI labels IT/FR/EN/ES, machine events unchanged.

dev.6: additive opt-in transport adapter with typed report, minute-rounded event times, durable bounded consent snapshot, HTTPS destination binding, no redirects and retry/revoke controls. No production endpoint or automatic transmission. Original telemetry privacy policy retained.
